nameOrigin: French for ‘Miss’, referring to a woman

pokedexEntries.bk: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

pokedexEntries.wh: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers’ life spans.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It can see the future from the movement of the stars. When it learns its Trainer’s life span, it cries in sadness.

pokedexEntries.sh: A criminal who was shown his fate by a Gothitelle went missing that same day and was never seen again.
